newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait approves privatisation of some oil units.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait approves privatisation of some oil units.

text.p: Kuwait's oil minister Abdul-Mohsen al-Mudej said on Tuesday a plan to privatise some oil sector units has been approved, the official Kuwait News Agency said.

"The programme is in its final stages and it has been approved by the Supreme Petroleum Council...(which) formed a panel to study this issue," the agency quoted Mudej as saying at a news conference. "The first phase of this project involves privatising 30 (petrol) stations."

After the 1990-91 Gulf crisis, Kuwait announced a wide-ranging plan to shed the state's stake in about 60 local firms and at a second stage state services such as water, electricity and selected oil facilities.
Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC), a state-owned conglomerate that runs the oil sector, has said it was preparing a time table for privatising some oil operations.
